title: Elf Bar ElfLiq Strawberry Watermelon Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Elfliq Strawberry Watermelon provides a straightforward, deeply satisfying fruit combination that celebrates authentic summer flavours. The inhale delivers the familiar, rich sweetness of ripe Strawberry, which is seamlessly layered with the distinctively crisp and intensely juicy notes of fresh Watermelon on the exhale, ensuring a highly refreshing finish. Blended to a versatile 50VG/50PG ratio, this premium nicotine salt e-liquid is perfectly suited for both Mouth-to-Lung (MTL) and Restricted Direct-to-Lung (RDL) vaping. It performs exceptionally well when paired with refillable pod kits and classic vape pens using coils rated between 0.6ohm and 1.2ohm. The use of high-quality nicotine salts ensures a wonderfully smooth throat hit alongside rapid, effective satisfaction. The Elfliq collection brings world-renowned flavour expertise to a convenient 10ml format. Produced to strict regulatory standards and available in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg nicotine strengths, this premium range allows you to experience intensely vivid and highly authentic fruit blends in your preferred refillable device.
